questionText:
In a directed acyclic graph with a source vertex $s$, the quality-score of a directed path is defined to be the product of the weights of the edges on the path. Further, for a vertex $v$ other than $s$, the quality-score of $v$ is defined to be the maximum among the quality-scores of all the paths from $s$ to $v$. The quality-score of $s$ is assumed to be 1.

The sum of the quality-scores of all the vertices in the graph shown above is ___________.
explanation:
To find the quality-score $Q(v)$ for each vertex $v$, we use dynamic programming / topological order to compute the maximum product of edge weights along any path from source $s$ to $v$.

Given:
$Q(s) = 1$

Step-by-step computation in topological order:
1. Vertex $a$:
Path: $s \rightarrow a$ with weight $9$
$Q(a) = 1 \times 9 = 9$

2. Vertex $c$:
Path: $s \rightarrow c$ with weight $1$
$Q(c) = 1 \times 1 = 1$

3. Vertex $b$:
Path: $a \rightarrow b$ with weight $1$
$Q(b) = Q(a) \times 1 = 9 \times 1 = 9$

4. Vertex $d$:
Incoming edges from $c$ (weight $1$) and $a$ (weight $1$):
$Q(d) = \max(Q(c) \times 1, Q(a) \times 1) = \max(1, 9) = 9$

5. Vertex $f$:
Path: $c \rightarrow f$ with weight $9$
$Q(f) = Q(c) \times 9 = 1 \times 9 = 9$

6. Vertex $g$:
Incoming edges from $f$ (weight $1$) and $d$ (weight $9$):
$Q(g) = \max(Q(f) \times 1, Q(d) \times 9) = \max(9 \times 1, 9 \times 9) = \max(9, 81) = 81$

7. Vertex $e$:
Incoming edges from $d$ (weight $9$) and $b$ (weight $1$):
$Q(e) = \max(Q(d) \times 9, Q(b) \times 1) = \max(9 \times 9, 9 \times 1) = \max(81, 9) = 81$

8. Vertex $t$:
Incoming edges from $g$ (weight $1$) and $e$ (weight $9$):
$Q(t) = \max(Q(g) \times 1, Q(e) \times 9) = \max(81 \times 1, 81 \times 9) = \max(81, 729) = 729$

Sum of Quality-Scores of all vertices:
$\text{Sum} = Q(s) + Q(a) + Q(b) + Q(c) + Q(d) + Q(e) + Q(f) + Q(g) + Q(t)$
$\text{Sum} = 1 + 9 + 9 + 1 + 9 + 81 + 9 + 81 + 729 = 929$
